proposal.model_rationale: The image is an Arabic letter from the Northern Region Airspace Safeguarding Office. It has a bordered table (Table 5-1, height limits per zone), but no ruled grid was detected, so every band was read as blocks. Each table cell is its own block naming its band and side, so all 20 text segments are covered. The numeral order in each line was taken from the band crops. Three things need a reviewer: (1) the visual order of the digits 5-1 in the table title; the order read matches the covering page's 'Table 5-1'. (2) The separator in 1,500 m, stored as U+066C and possibly a decimal mark. (3) The empty stamp outline on band 13 right, recorded as an empty English line. An Arabic line with no text failed check RD5. The final draft passes validate_reading (RD1, RD2, RD4, RD5, RD6, RD7 all pass). prepared_by is left empty for the controller to fill in, and nothing is approved.
